🎮 HOW TO PLAY

📱 Mobile Controls (On-Screen)
  • LEFT / RIGHT Buttons: Hold or slide your thumb between arrows to run smoothly.
  • JUMP (▲): Tap once to Jump, tap again in mid-air for a Double Jump!
  • DASH (⚡): Rocket forward through the air and smash through enemies!
⌨️ Keyboard Controls (PC / Laptop)
  • Move: Arrow Left / Right or A / D
  • Jump & Double Jump: Space, W, or Up Arrow
  • Dash Attack: Shift, K, or Z
  • Pause: P or Esc
⭐ Game Tips & Rules
  • Stomp Enemies: Land on top of Blue Slimes or Bat-Bots to squish them and bounce high!
  • Avoid Spikes: Red Spiky Walkers cannot be stomped from above—use your ⚡ Dash or jump over them!
  • Checkpoints (🚩): Touching a flag saves your spawn point in that level.
